occurrences.quote: the passages do not specify that Kitt won the Tony Award in 2007 (the musical won Tonys in 2009)
More critically, the passages contain no information about Janet Krupin or her involvement as a swing in the musical.
What year did Tom Kitt win the Tony Award, and did Janet Krupin perform as a swing in "Next to Normal"?

The claim is FALSE. While Brian Yorkey did compose the musical "Next to Normal" with composer Tom Kitt (who won the 2008 Outer Critics Circle Award), Janet Krupin was not a swing in "Next to Normal." According to the passages, Janet Krupin was a swing in the musical "If/Then" on Broadway, which is a different production.
Additionally, "Next to Normal" won Tony Awards in 2009, not 2007.
Was Janet Krupin a swing performer in "Next to Normal" or in a different Brian Yorkey musical, and in what year did Tom Kitt win the Tony Award for "Next to Normal"?
